# Angel Valladares

> Full-Stack & AI Software Engineer at AirPlx, working remotely. I build production web applications, APIs and AI/LLM features with Next.js, React, Node.js, TypeScript, Python and PostgreSQL.

This site is my personal portfolio and resume. It is available in English (`/en`) and Spanish (`/es`); both versions contain the same content. Every page is server-rendered static HTML, so no JavaScript execution is required to read it.

- Name: Angel Valladares
- Role: Full-Stack & AI Software Engineer at AirPlx (remote)
- Previously: Top Rated freelancer on Upwork with a 100% Job Success Score (remote)
- Core stack: TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, NestJS, Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Docker
- Contact: arivalladares2.0@gmail.com

## Projects

- [Yiddish Jobs](https://angelvalladares.dev/en/projects/yiddish-jobs): Job platform for the Yiddish-speaking community in Boro Park, New York. Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS.
- [Pinky's Store](https://angelvalladares.dev/en/projects/pinkys-store): E-commerce and inventory management system for a local cosmetics business. Next.js, React, Node.js, PostgreSQL.
